_what_this_is: THE RATCHET. Protected (.factory/locks/**, FACTORY_RULES §5) — only a human
commit moves these numbers. The gate asserts observed vs floor, and a second
check asserts floor(head) >= floor(base), so 'delete the assertion and
lower the number in the same commit' is not an available move.
exact — counts the harness itself owns (journey steps, holdout assertions,
check families). observed != floor FAILS the gate, forcing the raise
into the same human commit that accepted the new assertions. No slack
can accumulate where slack is deletable-assertion budget.
min   — the repo's organic test suites, which grow with nearly every commit.
observed < floor fails; observed > floor prints FLOOR_SLACK so the
gap stays visible every lap. Raise these on cadence, and any
standing slack pins the autonomy dial per the checklist rule.
_seed_these: Ships EMPTY. Seed every count from your project's own first honest green run, by human commit — inherited numbers from another project are meaningless here and would fail every gate.
_raise_these: In the same human commit that adds the assertions. If you find yourself lowering one, the question is what stopped being true.
